The main takeaway from our work is that

the K+ and $ \phi$(1020) meson production at the beam energy of 2A GeV is dominated by the baryon-baryon interactions, whereas for K- production, both the meson-baryon and baryon-bayron interactions are important.
we can use K± and $ phi$ meson production as probes of the nuclear matter properties at high baryonic densities.
